choices: two triangles similar to each other and to the original
questions.explanation: All three triangles share the same angles, so all three are similar.

questions.prompt: The altitude to the hypotenuse is the geometric mean of:
choices: the two segments of the hypotenuse
questions.explanation: Geometric Mean (Altitude) Theorem: $h = \sqrt{pq}$ where $p$ and $q$ are the hypotenuse pieces.
